text: Human Rights Watch and Amnesty International report that migrant workers in Saudi Arabia faced widespread labour abuses in 2025, including wage theft, and Human Rights Watch reports workers dying in avoidable workplace accidents.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: World Report 2026, Saudi Arabia
source.quote: Migrant workers continued to face widespread labor abuses, including wage theft and dying in gruesome yet avoidable workplace-related accidents

additionalSources.name: Amnesty International: Saudi Arabia 2025 (annual report country entry)
additionalSources.quote: Despite some limited reforms, labour abuses were widespread, with workers subjected to wage theft, unsafe working conditions, racial discrimination and substandard living conditions.
